title: Activity assignments
description: Who performs each activity in this venture, and whether a person approves it first (EE-172). An activity is one in the activity catalog or an APQC level 4 activity (EE-176). A person's decided answer to an activity proposal is merged into it (packages/naive/src/engine/activity-proposals.ts), and a person may write it. The file is operations/activity-assignments.json.

activities.description: Per activity: the id of an activity in packages/naive/src/functions/activities.json, or the hierarchy id of an APQC level 4 activity in packages/naive/src/functions/pcf.json, such as 3.5.1.6

performer.description: Who performs the activity: an agent, with a person checking a sample of the results, or a person

approval.description: Whether a person approves the activity each time before it is done
